# Hit Point Dice

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Stats](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#HitPointDice)*

Hit Point Dice, or Hit Dice for short, help determine a player character's Hit Point maximum, as explained in ["Creating a Character"](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/creating-a-character). Most monsters also have Hit Dice. A creature can spend Hit Dice during a Short Rest to regain [Hit Points](Hit-Points.md). *See also* "[Short Rest](../../Exploration/Short-Rest.md)."
